notes: isLocalOrPrivateHost is defined as a private free function inside this test file itself, not the main app: the audit's NetworkSafety type is iOS-only, and its macOS twin (MSCSettingsView.isLocalOrPrivateHost) is a private method on a SwiftUI View, unreachable even via @testable import. Per the source file's header comment, this suite pins a verbatim port of the iOS NetworkSafety rule set (including the IPv6 additions from S5) as the oracle instead. IPv6 handling (S5 addition): URL.host always strips brackets, so these fixtures use bare (unbracketed) IPv6 forms throughout.
